head: Apple Music on Android gets a new look
dek: Apple Music 7.0 for Android brings Apple's Liquid Glass design: a black or white icon, a floating bottom bar and blue instead of red accents.
details: Artist pages are redesigned, settings are regrouped, and Edit Pins and Edit Categories moved into the three-dot menu in your Library. The Now Playing screen stays the same. The version number now matches iOS 27.
where: Rolling out on the Play Store now
means: If you use Apple Music on Android, some buttons have moved: the Library's editing options are now in its three-dot menu.
todo: Update Apple Music from the Play Store if it hasn't updated on its own.
